# Game Idea: Space Drift

- Pilot a spaceship on an HTML canvas with arrow keys (thrust & rotate).
- Asteroids and debris drift across the screen; colliding destroys the ship.
- Collect energy orbs to score points and replenish fuel, which slowly drains.
- **Lose condition:** Ship is destroyed by collision or runs out of fuel.

1: // Simple Space Drift game – enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // starfield background
11:   const stars = [];
12:   for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
13:     stars.push({
14:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
15:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
16:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
17:     });
18:   }
19: 
20:   // thrust particles
21:   const particles = [];
22: 
23:   // audio setup
24:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
25:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
26:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
27:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
28:     osc.type = 'square';
29:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
30:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
31:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
32:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
33:     osc.start();
34:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
35:   }
36:   function playThrust() { playTone(200, 0.05); }
37:   function playExplosion() { playTone(100, 0.3); }
38:   function playCollect() { playTone(600, 0.1); }
39:   function playGameOver() { playTone(50, 0.5); }
40:   const ship = {
41:     x: canvas.width / 2,
42:     y: canvas.height / 2,
43:     angle: 0,
44:     vx: 0,
45:     vy: 0,
46:     radius: 10,
47:     alive: true,
48:   };
49: 
50:   let fuel = 100;
51:   let score = 0;
52:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false, ArrowUp: false };
53:   let gameOverPlayed = false;
54: 
55:   // generate asteroids
56:   const asteroids = [];
57:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
58:     asteroids.push({
59:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
60:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
61:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
62:       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
63:       radius: 15 + Math.random() * 20,
64:     });
65:   }
66: 
67:   // generate energy orbs
68:   const orbs = [];
69:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
70:     orbs.push({
71:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
72:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
73:       radius: 8,
74:     });
75:   }
76: 
77:   function drawShip() {
78:     ctx.save();
79:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
80:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
81:     ctx.beginPath();
82:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
83:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -8);
84:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 8);
85:     ctx.closePath();
86:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
87:     ctx.fill();
88:     ctx.restore();
89:   }
90: 
91:   function draw() {
92:     // background gradient
93:     const grd = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
94:     grd.addColorStop(0, '#000011');
95:     grd.addColorStop(1, '#000000');
96:     ctx.fillStyle = grd;
97:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
98: 
99:     // starfield
100:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
101:     stars.forEach(s => {
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
104:       ctx.fill();
105:     });
106: 
107:     // particles (thrust flame)
108:     particles.forEach(p => {
109:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,165,0,${p.life})`;
110:       ctx.beginPath();
111:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
112:       ctx.fill();
113:     });
114: 
115:     // asteroids with shading
116:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
117:       const radGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
118:       radGrad.addColorStop(0, '#888');
119:       radGrad.addColorStop(1, '#444');
120:       ctx.fillStyle = radGrad;
121:       ctx.beginPath();
122:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
123:       ctx.fill();
124:     });
125: 
126:     // energy orbs with glow
127:     orbs.forEach(o => {
128:       const orbGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.radius);
129:       orbGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.9)');
130:       orbGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.2)');
131:       ctx.fillStyle = orbGrad;
132:       ctx.beginPath();
133:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
134:       ctx.fill();
135:     });
136: 
137:     if (ship.alive) drawShip();
138: 
139:     // UI
140:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
141:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
142:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
143:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${fuel.toFixed(0)}`, 10, 40);
144:   }
145: 
146:   function update(dt) {
147:     // handle input
148:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= 0.04;
149:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += 0.04;
150:     if (keys.ArrowUp && fuel > 0) {
151:       const thrust = 0.1;
152:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
153:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
154:       fuel -= 0.03 * dt;
155:       // create thrust particle and sound
156:       particles.push({
157:         x: ship.x - Math.cos(ship.angle) * 12,
158:         y: ship.y - Math.sin(ship.angle) * 12,
159:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
160:         life: 1,
161:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
162:         vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
163:       });
164:       playThrust();
165:     }
166: 
167:     // move ship
168:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
169:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
170:     // wrap around edges
171:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += canvas.width;
172:     if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x -= canvas.width;
173:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += canvas.height;
174:     if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y -= canvas.height;
175: 
176:     // update particles
177:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
178:       const p = particles[i];
179:       p.x += p.vx * dt;
180:       p.y += p.vy * dt;
181:       p.life -= dt * 0.02;
182:       if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
183:     }
184: 
185:     // move asteroids
186:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
187:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
188:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
189:       if (a.x < 0) a.x += canvas.width;
190:       if (a.x > canvas.width) a.x -= canvas.width;
191:       if (a.y < 0) a.y += canvas.height;
192:       if (a.y > canvas.height) a.y -= canvas.height;
193:     });
194: 
195:     // check collisions with asteroids
196:     for (const a of asteroids) {
197:       const dx = ship.x - a.x;
198:       const dy = ship.y - a.y;
199:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
200:       if (dist < ship.radius + a.radius) {
201:         playExplosion();
202:         ship.alive = false;
203:         break;
204:       }
205:     }
206: 
207:     // check collisions with orbs
208:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
209:       const o = orbs[i];
210:       const dx = ship.x - o.x;
211:       const dy = ship.y - o.y;
212:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < ship.radius + o.radius) {
213:         fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 20);
214:         score += 10;
215:         playCollect();
216:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
217:       }
218:     }
219: 
220:     // lose condition fuel
221:     if (fuel <= 0 && ship.alive) {
222:       playGameOver();
223:       ship.alive = false;
224:     }
225:   }
226: 
227:   let last = performance.now();
228:   function loop(now) {
229:     const dt = (now - last) / 16.666; // normalize to ~60fps units
230:     last = now;
231:     if (ship.alive) {
232:       update(dt);
233:       draw();
234:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
235:     } else {
236:       draw();
237:       // play game over sound once
238:       if (!gameOverPlayed) {
239:         playGameOver();
240:         gameOverPlayed = true;
241:       }
242:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
243:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
244:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 120, canvas.height / 2);
245:     }
246:   }
247: 
248:   // input handlers
249:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
250:     // resume audio context on first user interaction
251:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
252:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = true;
253:   });
254:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
255:     if (e.key in keys) keys[e.key] = false;
256:   });
257: 
258:   // start
259:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
260: })();

(End of file - total 260 lines)
</content>
